seller.name: Mexican Freight Agentic Tracking and Tracing example
seller.summary: A demo of Mexican freight track-and-trace sold to AI agents per call. Synthetic trips on real corridors; no real carrier data.
seller.disclaimer: Example data for Hack the Andes. Trips, carriers and drivers are synthetic.

llms.summary: Where is my load? Live position, status, ETA, the driver's last WhatsApp update and data-quality flags for a shipment reference, as one machine-readable answer, 0.010 USD-TDN per call. A free check confirms a reference exists. Demo with synthetic trips MXF-1001 to MXF-1005 on real Mexican corridors.
examples: Free check: agent_checkout(catalog_item_id=<trip check id>, arguments={"trip_ref":"MXF-1002"}) -> exists, origin, destination, carrier.

Paid status, Spanish summary: agent_checkout(catalog_item_id=<trip status id>, arguments={"trip_ref":"MXF-1002"}) -> position, status, eta {at, delay_min, confidence}, last_driver_update, data_quality, summary.
Paid status, English summary: arguments={"trip_ref":"1004","lang":"en"} -> the alias block shows 1004 resolved to MXF-1004; flags gps_stale and driver_unresponsive.
Feedback: agent_checkout(catalog_item_id=<feedback id>, arguments={"message":"We need the ETA as a window, not a time."}).
llms.people: This is an example store built for the Hack the Andes hackathon (Lima, 17-18 Oct 2026) to show how a track-and-trace answer can be sold to AI agents per call on Qatom. Trips, carriers and drivers are synthetic.

items.name: Mexican freight example: trip status
items.listing_description: Live status of a Mexican freight shipment: position, status, ETA with delay and confidence, the driver's last WhatsApp update and data-quality flags, as one JSON answer. Send trip_ref; optional lang es or en for the summary. Check the reference free first with Mexican freight example: trip check. Example store: synthetic trips on real corridors, no real carrier data. References, examples and errors: {BASE}/llms.txt
